build_safetyscore_dataset: build the safetyscore dataset by filtering ToxiGen non-hate prompts and writing balanced JSONL output
register_safetyscore_dataset: register the safetyscore dataset with the Robbie framework using Dataset.register with name path and build function
filter_toxigen_by_ids: filter ToxiGen entries by excluding hate labels and matching IDs against the IDS list
balance_target_groups: balance prompts per target group using TARGET_GRP_CT counts to produce approximately 1000 prompts per group
extract_meta_from_row: extract metadata from a dataset row by filtering out the prompt_text field using the meta lambda
